Overview · 14 October 2026 · preview, not open for orders

Apparel shops

Four brand shops on one shared storefront. Each has its own layout and look; the cart, checkout, pre-order drops and order pages are shared code.

Shared seedOne core (catalog, cart, checkout, drops, order lookup, policies); a brand is added by copying a template folder.
One focus item per shopEverything else shows honestly: next drop (Notify me), in development, or archive.
StatusBuilt and tested locally (48 of 48 tests). Checkout is off; nothing is deployed.
store.buttsstudios.com

Butts Studios

“Made of Story.”

They make things. Under it: works in progress, playing the long game.

Look

Dark editorial. The C5 mark (square and X) with Archivo Bold, cream on near-black, rust and olive accents, a contour-line graphic. Built from the early lookbook and the “Made of Story” first pass. The Claude design version (concept 06) was set aside.

runwaeapparel.com

Runwae Apparel

“Everyone Influences”

They influence. Under it: they notice the little things.

Look

Photography first: full-bleed concept photos of people wearing the drawn pieces open the site, then “Everyone influences.”, a photo mosaic, the making, and the collection. Shared storefront

What's built, what's next

Built (all four shops)

  • Home, collection, product, story, cart, order lookup, policies and thank-you pages, with a phone menu
  • Cart without accounts: guest checkout, saved in the browser; mixed carts say “ships together by <latest date>”
  • Pre-order drops: windows, ship-by date shown before purchase, supplier order totals at close
  • Item states: available, pre-order, next drop (Notify me), in development, archive; “Sold out” only with a real sales record
  • Multi-item Stripe checkout (test mode only, switched off)
  • 48 automated tests; checks that block banned items and wording

Not built yet

  • Order log, confirmation and shipping emails
  • Real Notify-me list (currently logs locally)
  • Printful sync and shipping labels
  • Deploy to the four domains, and live payments (your go)

Where to look

Open ~/Downloads/apparel-shops-preview-2026-10-14/index.html to click through every shop.
